header:
# Town of Chittenden municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 6; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the 2025 Chittenden Town Report (132nd Annual Report), 'Chittenden Town Officers -- Terms of Office for March 2026' table, lists five Selectboard members: Kathleen Pratt (3-year term, 2024-2027), Andrew Quint (3-year, 2025-2028), Brenda Flower (2-year, 2025-2027), Dave Sargent (2-year, 2026-2028), and Gary Congdon (3-year, 2026-2029).

Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the approved Selectboard reorganization minutes of March 9, 2026 record the board appointing Kathie Pratt as Chair; Selectboard minutes of September 14 and September 28, 2026 list the same five members.

Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the 2025 Chittenden Town Report officers table ('Terms of Office for March 2026') lists the Moderator (1-year term, 2026-2027) as Bob Baird; the 2026 annual town meeting warning, Article 1, warned a Moderator election for a 1-year term.

Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the 2025 Chittenden Town Report officers table lists the Town Clerk under 'Office by Election' with a 3-year term (2024-2027): Alyssa Reynolds.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Alyssa Reynolds as Town Clerk of Chittenden.

Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the 2025 Chittenden Town Report officers table lists the Town Treasurer under 'Office by Election' with a 3-year term (2024-2027): Alyssa Reynolds.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Alyssa Reynolds as Town Treasurer of Chittenden.

Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the 2025 Chittenden Town Report officers table lists three Auditor seats: Jeff Spaulding (3-year term, 2026-2029), Jean Higgins (3-year, 2024-2027), and one seat (term 2025-2028) printed as Vacant; that seat is left unfilled. Article 9 of the 2026 warning proposed eliminating the office of Town Auditor under 17 V.S.A. section 2651b; no posted source records the article's outcome, and the post-election officers table continues to seat elected auditors, so the office stands.

Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the 2025 Chittenden Town Report officers table lists three Cemetery Commissioners: Bob Case (2025-2028), Herb Pelkey (2026-2029), and David Sargent (2024-2027); the 2026 warning, Article 1, warned a Cemetery Commissioner election for a 3-year term, and the 2026 sample ballot prints Herbert Pelkey as the candidate.

Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the 2025 Chittenden Town Report officers table lists the Delinquent Tax Collector under 'Office by Appointment' (3-year term, 2024-2027): Alyssa Reynolds. The holder is recorded as appointed.

Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the 2025 Chittenden Town Report officers table lists a single Trustee of Public Funds among the town's appointments: Alyssa Reynolds. The holder is recorded as appointed.

Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the approved Selectboard reorganization minutes of March 9, 2026 record the board appointing Gary Congdon as Road Commissioner (the pre-reorganization officers table had listed Dave Sargent). The holder is recorded as appointed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Chittenden (Rutland County) justices of the peace: Alison Briggs, Katherine Hall, Charles Ogg, Linda Reis, David Sargent, Jeffrey Spaulding, and Bradford White.

Town of Chittenden (Rutland County) official website, Meeting Documents & Reports page (town documents hosted on the town's Google Drive): the 2025 Chittenden Town Report officers table lists the same seven justices of the peace (2-year terms, February 1, 2025 - January 31, 2027).

jp_election.name: Town of Chittenden Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Chittenden (Rutland County) justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Alison Briggs, Katherine Hall, Charles Ogg, Linda Reis, David Sargent, Jeffrey Spaulding, and Bradford White. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
